notes: The Drowned Stair: a new fishing dungeon under the hill by your dock. Go down with nothing, catch fish in each flooded cave to open the stair, and find better gear the deeper you go. A boss fish guards every fifth floor. Climb out at the camp with your haul, or lose every heart and lose it all.
A bag for the dungeon: twelve slots, five gear slots (rod, reel, line, lure, charm) in five tiers, and things to use like Kelp Wraps and Homeward Shells.
Colour morphs: any lake fish can now bite in a rare colour (golden, ghost, shadow, koi, starry or prism), and they sell for much more.
The hatchery: a pond under the garden where pairs of fish lay eggs, and the young can take after their parents' colours. Release a morph to make that colour bite more often for a week.
The cabin has its own roomier window, with the tabs down the side and a view of the lake.
Four new badges: Fish Nursery, Every Colour, Into the Deep and The Bottom Step.
